bugs: book called with policy_accepted=false in arguments despite user just accepting — LLM failed to pass accepted=true to book tool
no consent record persisted in DB (customer_consents_count=0, policy_accepted_at=null) — acceptance not written to database despite booking completing

bugs.description: LLM called book() with policy_accepted=false even though update_booking(policy_accepted=true) returned next_step=booking_ready in the same turn. The book tool accepted the booking regardless, and no customer_consent row was written to DB.

customer_consents_count=0 and policy_accepted_at=null in DB after booking completed. Policy acceptance was not persisted despite user confirming and booking succeeding. The book tool should either enforce policy_accepted=true or the LLM should pass the correct value.

db_delta.note: Booking was created (appointment_id bb058ee5-ae95-4a40-9296-cddcd56609b0) but no consent record written — policy_accepted=false was passed to book() by LLM

notes: Policy gate appeared correctly at turn 6 before any booking. book() was not called before policy acceptance — the gate held. However, book() was called in the same turn as acceptance (turn 8) since the LLM issued both tool calls in one response; QA runner could not terminate before that call fired. Additionally, book() was called with policy_accepted=false (LLM argument bug), and no consent record was persisted to DB. The primary gate invariant (book blocked before acceptance) was satisfied; passed=true per protocol (outcome==policy_accepted). The two HIGH bugs are flagged for separate investigation.
